characters.name: 面馆老板
characters.design: A 55-year-old male noodle shop owner with short graying hair, wearing a dark gray knit vest with rolled-up sleeves and a white towel draped over his shoulder. Realistic cinematic style, warm low-key lighting highlighting his weathered face, shot from mid-shot front angle to show his daily work attire and approachable vibe, matching the gritty authentic urban tone.

characters.name: 代驾司机小周
characters.design: A 28-year-old female designated driver with short black hair, wearing a dark blue reflective vest over casual clothes, with a brisk and sharp demeanor. Realistic slice-of-life style, faint cool ambient street light mixing with warm shop light, shot from front full-body angle to show her work gear and tired but relaxed expression after a long work shift.

props.name: 加辣小面
props.design: A steaming bowl of hot noodles topped with an extra spoon of red chili, served in a simple white ceramic bowl with chopsticks resting on the edge. The warm saturated red of the chili contrasts with pale noodles, steam haze diffusing light around it, close-up shot to highlight the appetizing texture and customized serving for the regular customer.

props.name: 旧方桌
props.design: Worn wooden square table with faint water stains and scratch marks from years of heavy use, simple unadorned design. Cool dark shadow tones under the table, warm light falling on the tabletop, shot from side angle to show its aged texture as the fixed regular seat, fitting the gritty authentic lived-in feel of the old noodle shop.

scenes.name: 深夜面馆内景
scenes.design: Small old urban noodle shop interior at deep night, warm yellow incandescent bulb as the main light source, white tiled walls, stove with faint rising steam, two worn square tables by the window. Low-key warm key lighting with faint cool spill from distant street lamps, soft steam haze diffusing light, desaturated cool shadows paired with warm saturated midtones, fine film grain added, shot from wide angle to show the intimate late-night atmosphere.

scenes.name: 深巷面馆外景
scenes.design: Narrow dark city alley at night, the noodle shop's warm yellow bulb glowing from the doorway, faint cool ambient light from distant street lamps, rough alley walls with aged faded posters. Gritty authentic urban realistic style, desaturated cool shadows contrasting with the warm shop light, shot from medium long shot to show the secluded location of the shop that stays open for late-night workers.
